verdict.rationale: Notification tuning is a fair question for a chat and community platform like Discord, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of per-channel, keyword, or scheduled notification controls. The only related items are a community remark about receiving notifications and Social SDK social settings, neither of which is this capability.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can tune notifications per channel, keyword, and schedule so only what matters interrupts me
